questions.sampleA1: I like song. Happy song. It is good.
questions.sampleA2: My favourite song is 'Happy' by Pharrell. It's a very happy song and I like to dance to it. It makes me feel good because it's very cheerful. I like the video too.
questions.sampleB1: My favourite song is probably 'Walking on Sunshine' by Katrina & The Waves. I think it's a really uplifting song. It always puts me in a good mood when I hear it. For example, if I'm feeling down, I'll listen to it and it makes me feel better. It's quite an old song, but I still like it a lot.
questions.sampleB2: To be honest, it's really hard to pick just one, but I suppose my go-to song would be 'Fix You' by Coldplay. The thing is, it always manages to lift my spirits whenever I'm feeling a bit down. I love how the melody slowly builds up, and the lyrics genuinely strike a chord with me.
questions.uzSampleA1: Menga qo'shiq yoqadi. Xursandchilik qo'shig'i. U yaxshi.
questions.uzSampleA2: Mening eng sevimli qo'shig'im Farrelning 'Happy' qo'shig'i. Bu juda xursandchilik qo'shig'i va men unga raqsga tushishni yaxshi ko'raman. U meni yaxshi his qildiradi, chunki u juda quvnoq. Menga videoklip ham yoqadi.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Mening eng sevimli qo'shig'im, ehtimol, Katrina & The Waves guruhining 'Walking on Sunshine' qo'shig'idir. Menimcha, bu juda ko'tarinki qo'shiq. Uni eshitganimda doim kayfiyatimni ko'taradi.
Masalan, agar o'zimni xafa his qilsam, uni eshitaman va u meni yaxshiroq his qilishimga yordam beradi. Bu ancha eski qo'shiq, lekin menga hali ham juda yoqadi.
questions.uzSampleB2: Agar men eng sevimli qo'shiqni tanlashim kerak bo'lsa, menimcha, Treysi Chepmenning "Fast Car" qo'shig'ini aytgan bo'lardim. Bu juda ta'sirchan qo'shiq bo'lib, kuchli hikoyani aytib beradi. Men uchun ayniqsa diqqatga sazovor tomoni shundaki, u nisbatan oddiy ohang ichida qashshoqlik kurashini va yaxshiroq hayotga intilishni qanday aks ettirishi. Qo'shiq so'zlari juda ta'sirli va Chepmenning ovozi qo'shiqning hissiy og'irligini yetkazish uchun juda mos keladi. Garchi bu juda xomush qo'shiq bo'lsa-da, menimcha, bu chindan ham vaqt sinovidan o'tgan go'zal va muhim musiqiy asar.

vocabulary.title: Q1 - What is your favourite song?...
idioms: "Hit all the right notes" - "Hamma to'g'ri notalarni ur"
sentenceStarters: "Honestly speaking, I find it difficult to choose a single favourite song as music is such a vast and varied art form." - "Rostini aytsam, musiqani tanlash qiyin, chunki musiqiy san'at juda keng va xilma-xil."

"From my perspective, a song that truly resonates with me is one that evokes deep emotions and memories." - "Mening nuqtai nazarimdan, men bilan haqiqatan rezonanslashadigan qo'shiq chuqur his-tuyg'ular va xotiralarni uyg'otadi."

"I'd have to say that a perfect song for me is one that combines profound lyrics with a captivating melody." - "Shuni aytishim kerakki, men uchun mukammal qo'shiq chuqur ma'noli so'zlar va maftunkor ohangni birlashtiradi."

questions.sampleAnswer:
Without a shadow of a doubt, my favourite song is "Bohemian Rhapsody" by Queen. This masterpiece truly resonates with me on multiple levels. The song's unique blend of rock, opera, and ballad elements is incredibly captivating, and I can pick up on different nuances every time I listen to it. I find it absolutely astonishing how Queen managed to create such an iconic piece that still seems completely fresh despite being released over four decades ago.

One of the reasons why this song stands out for me is its lyrical depth. It takes the listener through a tumultuous yet poetic journey, which, to me, paints a vivid picture of internal conflict and liberation. As the saying goes, "Music is the shorthand of emotion," and "Bohemian Rhapsody" epitomizes this sentiment perfectly. Freddie Mercury's extraordinary vocal performance is complemented by the band's phenomenal instrumentation, creating a timeless classic.

Moreover, this song has a personal connection for me. I remember vividly the first time I heard it during a family road trip; it was a game changer. Since then, it has been the anthem for numerous celebrations and moments of introspection in my life. Honestly, it serves as a reminder to let my hair down and embrace life's unpredictability. Ultimately, "Bohemian Rhapsody" is not just a song; it's a musical experience that continues to stand the test of time.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Shubhasiz, mening eng sevimli qo'shig'im Queen guruhining "Bohemian Rhapsody" qo'shig'i. Bu durdona asar men bilan bir necha darajada chin dildan hamohang. Qo'shiqning rok, opera va ballada elementlarining o'ziga xos aralashmasi nihoyatda jozibali va men uni har safar tinglaganimda turli nuanslarni ilg'ay olaman. Queen qanday qilib shunday ikonik asar yaratganiga mutlaqo hayron qolaman, u to'rt o'n yildan ko'proq vaqt oldin chiqarilganiga qaramay, butunlay yangidek tuyuladi.

Bu qo'shiqning men uchun ajralib turishining sabablaridan biri uning lirik chuqurligidir. U tinglovchini g'alayonli, ammo poetik sayohatga olib boradi, bu men uchun ichki ziddiyat va ozodlikning yorqin manzarasini chizadi. Aytganlaridek, "Musiqa - bu hissiyotning qisqa yo'li", va "Bohemian Rhapsody" bu tuyg'uni mukammal tarzda o'zida mujassam etgan. Freddi Merkurining ajoyib vokal ijrosi guruhning fenomenal instrumentalligi bilan to'ldiriladi va abadiy klassikani yaratadi.

Bundan tashqari, bu qo'shiqning men uchun shaxsiy aloqasi bor. Oilaviy sayohat paytida uni birinchi marta eshitganim esimda; bu tub burilish yasagan edi. O'shandan beri u hayotimdagi ko'plab bayramlar va ichki mushohada lahzalarining madhiyasi bo'lib kelgan. Rostini aytsam, u meni sochlarimni yoyib yuborishga va hayotning oldindan aytib bo'lmaydiganligini qabul qilishga undaydi. Oxir oqibat, "Bohemian Rhapsody" shunchaki qo'shiq emas; bu vaqt sinovidan o'tishda davom etayotgan musiqiy tajriba.

questions.prompt: Do you prefer to read local news or international news?
questions.sampleA1:
I like local news.

It is easy.

I know the people.
questions.sampleA2:
I like local news and international news.

But I think local news is more important because it is about my town.

I can help my neighbors.
questions.sampleB1:
I prefer to read local news.

I think it's important to know what's happening in my community.

For example, I want to know about new shops or events.

However, I also read international news sometimes to understand the world better.
questions.sampleB2: Personally, I tend to go for international news more than local stuff. To be honest, it gives me a much broader picture of what's going on around the world. That said, I do keep up with local headlines too, since it's important to know what's happening on my doorstep. But overall, global affairs win it for me.
questions.uzSampleA1:
Men mahalliy yangiliklarni yoqtiraman.

U oson.

Men odamlarni bilaman.
questions.uzSampleA2:
Men mahalliy yangiliklarni ham, xalqaro yangiliklarni ham yoqtiraman.

Lekin menimcha mahalliy yangiliklar muhimroq, chunki u mening shahrim haqida.

Men qo'shnilarimga yordam bera olaman.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Men mahalliy yangiliklarni o'qishni afzal ko'raman.

Menimcha, o'z jamoamda nima bo'layotganini bilish muhim.

Masalan, men yangi do'konlar yoki tadbirlar haqida bilmoqchiman.

Biroq, dunyoni yaxshiroq tushunish uchun ba'zan xalqaro yangiliklarni ham o'qiyman.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Men mahalliy yangiliklardan ko'ra ko'proq xalqaro yangiliklarni o'qishga moyilman.

Mahalliy voqealar, shubhasiz, dolzarb bo'lsa-da, men xalqaro yangiliklar global muammolar va tendentsiyalarga kengroq nuqtai nazarni taqdim etadi deb o'ylayman.

Bu menga murakkab geosiyosiy vaziyatlarni tushunishga va turli madaniy nuqtai nazarlarni ko'rib chiqishga imkon beradi.

Albatta, mahalliy voqealardan xabardor bo'lib turish ham muhim, lekin menimcha, xalqaro yangiliklarga e'tibor qaratish yanada xabardor va global miqyosda ongni rivojlantiradi.

vocabulary.title: Q2 - Do you prefer to read local news or international ...
idioms: Being a bookworm, I consume both local and international news with great enthusiasm - "Kitobxon sifatida, men mahalliy va xalqaro yangiliklarni katta qiziqish bilan o'qiyman"
"A room without books is like a body without a soul," and similarly, a life without news feels incomplete - "Kitobsiz xona jonsiz tanaga o'xshaydi, xuddi shunday, yangiliklarsiz hayot to'liq emasdek"
A well-written article can be a true page-turner, keeping me engaged till the very end - "Yaxshi yozilgan maqola haqiqiy qiziqarli kitob bo'lishi mumkin va meni oxirigacha qiziqtirib qo'yadi"
phrases: extensive collection of news sources helps me stay well-informed - "yangiliklar manbalarining keng kolleksiyasi meni yaxshi xabardor qiladi"
As an avid reader of international affairs, I keep track of global developments - "Xalqaro ishlardan qizg'in o'quvchi sifatida, global rivojlanishlarni kuzatib boraman"

Local news can sometimes feel like literary treasures that reveal the hidden dynamics of my own community - "Ba'zida mahalliy yangiliklar mening jamoamning yashirin dinamikasini ochib beruvchi adabiy xazinalar kabi tuyulishi mumkin"
sentenceStarters: "Honestly speaking, I find myself gravitating towards international news as it broadens my understanding of global affairs." - "Rostini aytsam, men global ishlardan xabardor bo'lish uchun xalqaro yangiliklarga qiziqaman."

"From my perspective, both local and international news hold significant value, as they together create a comprehensive view of the world." - "Mening nuqtai nazarimdan, mahalliy va xalqaro yangiliklar birgalikda dunyoni to'liq ko'rinishda tasvirlaydi va muhim ahamiyatga ega."

"I'd have to say that my preference often shifts depending on the current events and their impact on my community or the world at large." - "Shuni aytishim kerakki, mening afzalligim ko'pincha joriy voqealarga va ularning mening jamoam yoki umuman dunyoga ta'siriga qarab o'zgaradi."

questions.sampleAnswer: To be honest, I let my hair down more often with international news as opposed to local news. There's something incredibly fascinating about gaining insight into global events and current affairs that impact the world at large. This opens up new perspectives and provides a broader understanding of how interconnected we are as a global community. For instance, reading about groundbreaking scientific discoveries or significant geopolitical shifts allows me to see the bigger picture, which I find immensely rewarding. While local events are important, I feel that international news keeps me on my toes by challenging my preconceived notions and encouraging a more nuanced understanding of cultural differences. As "knowledge is power," staying informed globally empowers me to engage in more meaningful conversations and make informed decisions in both personal and professional contexts.
questions.uzSampleAnswer: Rostini aytsam, mahalliy yangiliklarga qaraganda xalqaro yangiliklar bilan ko'proq dam olaman. Dunyo miqyosidagi voqealar va dolzarb masalalarga oid tushunchaga ega bo'lishda nihoyatda hayratlanarli bir narsa bor. Bu yangi istiqbollarni ochadi va global hamjamiyat sifatida qanchalik o'zaro bog'liqligimizni kengroq tushunishni ta'minlaydi. Misol uchun, ilmiy sohadagi yangi kashfiyotlar yoki muhim geosiyosiy o'zgarishlar haqida o'qish menga katta rasmni ko'rish imkonini beradi, bu menga juda katta zavq bag'ishlaydi. Mahalliy voqealar muhim bo'lsa-da, xalqaro yangiliklar mening oldindan shakllangan tushunchalarimga qarshi chiqish va madaniy farqlarni yanada nozik tushunishga undash orqali meni hushyor tutadi deb o'ylayman. "Bilim - kuch" ekan, global miqyosda xabardor bo'lib turish menga yanada mazmunli suhbatlarda qatnashishga va shaxsiy va professional kontekstlarda ongli qarorlar qabul qilishga imkon beradi.

questions.prompt: Who taught you to be polite?
questions.sampleA1: My mum. She says 'please'. She says 'thank you'.
questions.sampleA2: My mother taught me. She told me to say please and thank you. And she said be nice to people. Because it is good.
questions.sampleB1: I think my parents taught me to be polite. They always told me to be respectful of other people. For example, they said I should say 'please' and 'thank you'. Also, they showed me how to treat guests when they came to our house. I think it's important to be polite.
questions.sampleB2: Well, I'd have to say my grandmother, without a doubt. She was the one who drummed good manners into me from a really young age. The thing is, she always led by example, so being courteous just came naturally. I suppose I picked up most of my politeness simply from watching how kindly she treated everyone.
questions.uzSampleA2: Menga onam o'rgatgan. U menga iltimos va rahmat deyishni aytdi. Va u odamlarga yaxshi munosabatda bo'lishni aytdi. Chunki bu yaxshi.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Menimcha, ota-onam meni odobli bo'lishga o'rgatgan. Ular doim boshqa odamlarni hurmat qilishim kerakligini aytishardi.
Masalan, ular "iltimos" va "rahmat" deyishim kerakligini aytishardi. Shuningdek, ular bizning uyimizga mehmonlar kelganida ularga qanday munosabatda bo'lishni ko'rsatishdi. Menimcha, odobli bo'lish muhim.
questions.uzSampleB2: Menimcha, odobli bo'lishni o'rgatishda asosan ota-onam mas'ul edi. Yoshligimdan boshlab, ular yaxshi odob-axloq va boshqalarga, kelib chiqishidan qat'i nazar, hurmat bilan munosabatda bo'lish muhimligini ta'kidlashdi. Ular doimo boshqa odamlarning his-tuyg'ularini hisobga olishni va har doim so'zlarim va harakatlarimga e'tiborli bo'lishni eslatib turishardi. Bundan tashqari, ularning boshqalar bilan munosabatlarini kuzatishning o'zi ham qimmatli saboq bo'ldi. Ular har doim xushmuomala va e'tiborli bo'lishga harakat qilishardi, bu esa, tabiiyki, mening xulq-atvorimga ta'sir qildi.

vocabulary.title: Q3 - Who taught you to be polite?...
idioms: "Politeness costs nothing but gains everything" - "Odob-axloq hech narsa xarajat qilmaydi, lekin hamma narsani qo'lga kiritadi"
as polite as a picture - "tasvirdagi kabi odobli"
sentenceStarters: "Honestly speaking, I owe my understanding of politeness to my parents, who instilled these values in me from a young age." - "Rostini aytsam, odob-axloq haqida tushunchamni bolaligimdan menga bu qadriyatlarni singdirgan ota-onamdan olganman."

"From my perspective, the lessons of politeness were imparted to me by my grandparents, whose wisdom and grace were remarkable." - "Mening nuqtai nazarimdan, menga odob-axloq saboqlarini hikmatlari va nazokatlari ajoyib bo'lgan bobom va buvim berganlar."

"I'd have to say that my teachers played a pivotal role in teaching me the nuances of being polite in various social situations." - "Shuni aytishim kerakki, turli ijtimoiy vaziyatlarda odobli bo‘lishning nozik jihatlarini o‘rgatishda o‘qituvchilarim muhim rol o‘ynaganlar."

questions.sampleAnswer:
Reflecting on my upbringing, I genuinely believe that politeness was something instilled in me quite early on by my parents. They have always emphasized the importance of treating others with respect and kindness, which goes a long way in maintaining harmonious relationships. My mother, in particular, was incredibly diligent in teaching me the basics of courtesy, like saying ‘please’ and ‘thank you,’ and she would often remind me to hold the door for others.

Moreover, during family gatherings, I observed my parents engaging with guests in a sophisticated manner, always ensuring that everyone felt comfortable and welcome. This environment fostered a natural inclination towards politeness. Additionally, one of my teachers in elementary school also played a pivotal role by setting an example through her impeccable manners and constant encouragement to be considerate towards classmates.

As I grew older, I learned that politeness is not merely about following rules; it's about empathizing with others and creating a positive social experience. My family and educators always reminded me that "manners maketh man", and I carry this wisdom with me to this day, applying it in all my interactions.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Tarbiya haqida o‘ylab, men ota-onam tomonidan odob-axloq menga juda erta singdirilganiga chin dildan ishonaman. Ular doimo boshqalarga hurmat va mehr bilan munosabatda bo'lish muhimligini ta'kidlashgan, bu esa uyg'un munosabatlarni saqlashda juda katta ahamiyatga ega. Ayniqsa, onam menga "iltimos" va "rahmat" kabi odob-axloq asoslarini o'rgatishda juda tirishqoq edi va u tez-tez boshqalar uchun eshikni ushlab turishni eslatib turardi.

Bundan tashqari, oilaviy yig'inlar paytida ota-onamning mehmonlar bilan murakkab tarzda muloqot qilishlarini kuzatdim, ular doimo hamma o'zini qulay va xush qarshi olingan his qilishini ta'minlashardi. Bu muhit odob-axloqqa tabiiy moyillikni shakllantirdi. Bundan tashqari, boshlang'ich maktabdagi o'qituvchilarimdan biri ham o'zining benuqson odobi va sinfdoshlarga nisbatan e'tiborli bo'lishga doimiy undashi orqali namuna ko'rsatib, muhim rol o'ynadi.

Ulғayganim sari, odob-axloq shunchaki qoidalarga rioya qilish emasligini, balki boshqalarga hamdard bo'lish va ijobiy ijtimoiy tajriba yaratish ekanligini angladim. Oilam va ustozlarim doimo "odob odamning ziynati" ekanligini eslatib turishardi va men bu hikmatni bugungi kungacha o'zim bilan olib yuraman va uni barcha munosabatlarimda qo'llayman.

questions.sampleA2:
I see a shop and a phone.

The woman is looking at clothes.

I think she likes the shop because it is big.
questions.sampleB1:
In the first picture, I see someone using their phone to shop online, I think.

And in the second picture, there is a woman looking at clothes in a store.

Maybe she is buying something.

I think shopping is fun, but it can also be expensive.
questions.sampleB2: So, looking at these two photos, both of them are clearly about shopping, but in quite different ways. In the first one, someone's holding a smartphone and browsing an online shopping app called eMARKET, with categories like fashion and electronics on the screen. Interestingly, there's a blurry clothes shop in the background. The second picture, on the other hand, shows a young woman in a shop, happily flicking through clothes on a rail. To me, they nicely sum up the contrast between shopping online and heading to an actual store.
questions.uzSampleA1:
Men do'konni ko'ryapman.

Men kiyimlarni ko'ryapman.

Men telefonni ko'ryapman.
questions.uzSampleA2:
Men do'kon va telefonni ko'ryapman.

Ayol kiyimga qarayapti.

Menimcha, unga do'kon yoqadi, chunki u katta.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Birinchi rasmda, men kimdir telefondan onlayn xarid qilayotganini ko'ryapman, menimcha.

Birinchi suratda kimdir telefonda ilova ishlatayotganga o'xshaydi, ehtimol onlayn xarid uchun. Bu odamlar hozir istalgan joydan xarid qilishi mumkinligini ko'rsatadi.

Onlayn xarid qulay, lekin do'konga borish ko'proq tajriba beradi.

vocabulary.title: Q4 - Look at the photographs. What do you see in these ...
idioms: "A picture paints a thousand words" - "Rasm ming so'zga teng"
freeze a moment in time - "vaqtni bir lahzaga muzlatish"
sentenceStarters: "Honestly speaking, I am captivated by the vibrant hues and intricate details that each photograph portrays." - "Rostini aytsam, har bir suratning yorqin ranglari va murakkab tafsilotlari meni o'ziga tortadi."

"From my perspective, these images encapsulate a profound narrative, each telling a unique story through its visual elements." - "Mening nuqtai nazarimdan, bu tasvirlar chuqur bir hikoyani o'z ichiga oladi, har biri o'zining vizual elementlari orqali noyob bir hikoyani aytib beradi."

"I'd have to say that the photographs are a window into diverse worlds, offering glimpses into cultures, emotions, and experiences." - "Shuni aytishim kerakki, fotosuratlar xilma-xil dunyolarga deraza bo'lib, madaniyatlar, hissiyotlar va tajribalarni ko'rsatib beradi."

questions.sampleAnswer: "A picture is worth a thousand words", and these images truly capture the essence of modern shopping experiences. In the first photograph, I see a person holding a smartphone, intricately exploring the online shopping app "eMARKET." This image perfectly encapsulates the digital shopping revolution that has taken over our lives. The warm lighting and blurred background, elegantly hinting at racks of clothes, suggest that the person might be inside a high-street store. This fusion of online and offline shopping creates a seamless shopping experience that many of us have come to rely on. Moving on to the second image, we see a woman browsing through clothes in what appears to be a bright and airy store. The natural light streaming in through the large windows effortlessly enhances the pleasant atmosphere. Her light pink top and the varied, colorful apparel on the rack indicate that she is enjoying a leisurely shopping trip. The presence of another person in the background, holding a drink and a handbag, adds a touch of realism, highlighting the social aspect of shopping. This image effectively portrays how shopping can be a way to let your hair down and enjoy some quality time out. In reflecting on these images, it's readily apparent that both online and physical shopping have their unique allure. While one offers convenience and efficiency, the other provides a tactile, social experience that can be incredibly satisfying. "Variety is the spice of life", and thankfully, modern consumers have the best of both worlds at their fingertips.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
"Bir rasm ming so'zga arziydi", va bu rasmlar zamonaviy xarid qilish tajribalarining mohiyatini chinakam aks ettiradi. Birinchi suratda men qo'lida smartfon ushlagan, "eMARKET" onlayn xarid qilish ilovasini murakkab tarzda o'rganayotgan odamni ko'ryapman. Bu rasm hayotimizni egallab olgan raqamli xarid qilish inqilobini mukammal tarzda o'zida mujassam etgan. Issiq yorug'lik va xira fon, kiyim tokchalariga nafis ishora qilib, odam gavjum ko'chadagi do'konda bo'lishi mumkinligini ko'rsatadi. Onlayn va oflayn xaridlarning bu uyg'unligi ko'pchiligimiz ishonadigan uzluksiz xarid qilish tajribasini yaratadi.

Ikkinchi rasmga o'tsak, biz yorug' va havodor do'konga o'xshagan joyda kiyim tanlayotgan ayolni ko'ramiz. Katta derazalardan tushayotgan tabiiy yorug'lik yoqimli muhitni bemalol yaxshilaydi. Uning och pushti rangi va tokchadagi turli xil, rang-barang kiyimlar u bemalol xarid qilishdan zavqlanayotganini ko'rsatadi. Orqa fonda ichimlik va sumka ushlagan boshqa odamning borligi realizm tuyg'usini qo'shadi va xarid qilishning ijtimoiy jihatini ta'kidlaydi. Bu rasm xarid qilish dam olish va sifatli vaqt o'tkazish usuli bo'lishi mumkinligini samarali tasvirlaydi.

Bu rasmlar haqida o'ylar ekanman, onlayn va jismoniy xaridlarning o'ziga xos jozibasi borligi yaqqol ko'rinadi. Birinchisi qulaylik va samaradorlikni taklif qilsa, ikkinchisi juda qoniqarli bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan sezgir, ijtimoiy tajribani taqdim etadi. "Hayotning mazasi xilma-xillikda", va yaxshiyamki, zamonaviy iste'molchilarning qo'lida ikkala dunyoning eng yaxshi imkoniyatlari mavjud.

questions.prompt: Which way of shopping has more advantages?
questions.sampleA1: I like shop online. It is easy. I buy shoes. And food.
questions.sampleA2: I think online shopping is better. Because it is easy and fast. You can buy many things. And the shops are open all the time. But I like to go to shops too, because I can see things before I buy them.
questions.sampleB1: Well, in my opinion, online shopping has more advantages. For example, it's very convenient because you can shop from home. Also, there is a bigger selection of things to buy online. However, sometimes it's nice to go to a real shop and try things on before you buy them. But overall, I think online shopping is better.

questions.sampleAnswer:
In today's digital age, shopping has undergone a significant transformation. While traditional high-street stores offer a tangible experience, online shopping has its own set of unique advantages. Personally, I firmly believe that online shopping has more benefits, and I'll elaborate on this perspective.

Firstly, arguably the most compelling advantage of online shopping is convenience. With just a few clicks, one can pick up the desired item from the comfort of their home. This not only saves time but also eliminates the need to step into crowded malls. Furthermore, the wide array of choices available online is simply incomparable. Whether you're looking for niche products or popular brands, the internet offers an incredibly diverse selection.

Moreover, online platforms often provide exclusive deals and discounts, which can be a game-changer for price-sensitive consumers. On the flip side, shopping in a physical store can be seen as a social experience, allowing individuals to let their hair down and engage with friends. However, in our increasingly hectic lifestyles, the efficiency and cost-effectiveness of online shopping often outweigh the social aspect of traditional shopping.

In conclusion, while both methods of shopping have their own unique merits, I am genuinely convinced that the advantages of online shopping are more pronounced. As the saying goes, "Time is money," and online shopping allows us to save both, without compromising on variety or quality.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Bugungi kunda raqamli asrda xarid qilish sezilarli o'zgarishlarga duch keldi. An'anaviy ko'cha do'konlari aniq tajribani taklif qilsa-da, onlayn xarid qilishning o'ziga xos afzalliklari mavjud. Shaxsan men, onlayn xarid qilish ko'proq foyda keltiradi deb qat'iy ishonaman va men bu nuqtai nazarni batafsil bayon qilaman.

Birinchidan, onlayn xarid qilishning eng muhim afzalligi - bu qulaylik. Bir necha marta bosish orqali, odam o'z uyidan turib kerakli narsani sotib olishi mumkin. Bu nafaqat vaqtni tejaydi, balki gavjum savdo markazlariga borish zaruratini ham yo'q qiladi. Bundan tashqari, onlaynda mavjud bo'lgan keng tanlov shunchaki taqqoslanmaydi. Siz tor mahsulotlarni yoki mashhur brendlarni qidiryapsizmi, internet juda xilma-xil tanlovni taklif etadi.

Bundan tashqari, onlayn platformalar ko'pincha eksklyuziv takliflar va chegirmalarni taqdim etadi, bu narxga sezgir iste'molchilar uchun katta o'zgarish bo'lishi mumkin. Boshqa tomondan, jismoniy do'konda xarid qilish ijtimoiy tajriba sifatida ko'rilishi mumkin, bu odamlarga dam olish va do'stlar bilan muloqot qilish imkonini beradi. Biroq, bizning tobora band bo'lib borayotgan turmush tarzimizda, onlayn xarid qilishning samaradorligi va tejamkorligi ko'pincha an'anaviy xarid qilishning ijtimoiy jihatidan ustun turadi.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, xarid qilishning ikkala usuli ham o'ziga xos afzalliklarga ega bo'lsa-da, men onlayn xarid qilishning afzalliklari yanada yaqqolroq ekanligiga chin dildan ishonaman. Aytganlaridek, "Vaqt - pul", va onlayn xarid qilish bizga xilma-xillik yoki sifatni yo'qotmasdan, ikkalasini ham tejashga imkon beradi.

questions.sampleAnswer:
The advent of the Internet has undoubtedly transformed the way we shop, turning the shopping landscape on its head. In the past, people had to physically visit high-street stores to purchase items, but now, conveniently, they can shop from the comfort of their home.

With the rise of e-commerce platforms like Amazon and Alibaba, consumers have access to a broader range of products, often at more competitive prices. This dramatic shift means that traditional retail has to step up its game to remain relevant and appealing to tech-savvy customers. For example, I frequently find myself browsing online for electronics and clothing because of the sheer convenience and availability of customer reviews, which give me peace of mind about my purchases.

Moreover, the Internet has catalyzed the trend of personalized shopping experiences. Retailers can now track consumer habits and tailor their marketing strategies accordingly. As a result, advertisements are often specifically targeted, making them more effective and relevant. Personally, I find it fascinating how algorithms pick up on my preferences and suggest products that genuinely interest me.

In essence, while there are significant advantages to online shopping, such as greater accessibility and choice, it's crucial to remember that "all that glitters is not gold". The Internet has also introduced challenges like cybersecurity risks and the decline of local businesses. However, as technology continues to evolve and improve, I believe we will see even more innovative solutions that bridge the gap between traditional and online shopping experiences.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Internetning paydo bo'lishi, shubhasiz, xarid qilish usulimizni tubdan o'zgartirdi, xarid qilish manzarasini butunlay o'zgartirib yubordi. Ilgari odamlar tovarlarni sotib olish uchun markaziy ko'chalardagi do'konlarga borishga majbur edilar, ammo hozir, qulay tarzda, ular o'z uylarida xarid qilishlari mumkin.

Amazon va Alibaba kabi elektron tijorat platformalarining rivojlanishi bilan iste'molchilar mahsulotlarning kengroq assortimentiga, ko'pincha raqobatbardosh narxlarda ega bo'lishdi. Bu keskin o'zgarish shuni anglatadiki, an'anaviy chakana savdo texnologiyani yaxshi biladigan mijozlar uchun dolzarb va jozibador bo'lib qolish uchun o'z o'yinini kuchaytirishi kerak. Misol uchun, men ko'pincha elektronika va kiyim-kechaklarni onlayn tarzda ko'rib chiqaman, chunki bu juda qulay va mijozlarning fikrlari mavjudligi, bu esa xaridlarim haqida xotirjamlik beradi.

Bundan tashqari, Internet shaxsiy xarid qilish tajribasi tendentsiyasini tezlashtirdi. Chakana sotuvchilar endi iste'molchilar odatlarini kuzatib borishlari va marketing strategiyalarini shunga mos ravishda moslashtirishlari mumkin. Natijada, reklamalar ko'pincha maqsadli yo'naltirilgan bo'lib, ularni yanada samarali va dolzarb qiladi. Shaxsan men algoritmlar mening afzalliklarimni qanday aniqlashi va meni chinakam qiziqtirgan mahsulotlarni taklif qilishi meni hayratga soladi.

Aslida, onlayn xarid qilishning katta afzalliklari, masalan, katta qulaylik va tanlov mavjud bo'lsa-da, "yaltiragan har bir narsa oltin emas"ligini unutmaslik kerak. Internet, shuningdek, kiberxavfsizlik xavfi va mahalliy biznesning pasayishi kabi muammolarni keltirib chiqardi. Biroq, texnologiya rivojlanishda va takomillashishda davom etar ekan, biz an'anaviy va onlayn xarid qilish tajribasi o'rtasidagi tafovutni bartaraf etadigan yanada innovatsion echimlarni ko'ramiz, deb ishonaman.

bulletPoints: Can you describe your experience of playing or watching a sport?
What could be done to encourage more people to take up sports in their free time?
Do you think hosting major sports events benefits the host country?
questions.sampleAnswer:
When it comes to discussing my experience with sports, I must say I've grown up being both an avid participant and a keen spectator. From a young age, I was involved in playing football, which has always been close to my heart. The thrill of being on the field, feeling the adrenaline rush as the game unfolds, is something I find immensely rewarding. Moreover, watching live sports, especially international football matches, is an experience I find incredibly exhilarating. The atmosphere in the stadium, the camaraderie among fans, and the electric energy of the crowd create a social experience that is hard to replicate elsewhere.

In terms of encouraging more individuals to take up sports in their leisure time, I believe there are several strategies that could be put into place. Firstly, initiatives by local governments to provide accessible and affordable sports facilities would be highly beneficial. Additionally, organizing community sports events could spark interest and foster a sense of community spirit. Schools and workplaces can also play a pivotal role by encouraging sports through various programs and competitions that bring people together.

As for hosting major sports events, I genuinely believe they can be a double-edged sword. On one hand, they offer great opportunities for the host country to showcase itself on a global stage, potentially boosting tourism and creating economic growth. Such events can also unite communities and instill a sense of national pride. However, on the flip side, they can strain local resources and often lead to significant costs that might not always be recuperated. Ultimately, "all that glitters is not gold", and careful planning and execution are essential to ensure that the benefits outweigh the drawbacks.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Sport bilan bog'liq tajribam haqida gapiradigan bo'lsam, men ham faol ishtirokchi, ham qiziquvchan tomoshabin sifatida ulg'ayganman, deyishim kerak. Yoshligimdan futbol o'ynashga jalb qilinganman, bu doim yuragimga yaqin bo'lgan. Maydonda bo'lish, o'yin davomida adrenalinning ko'tarilishini his qilish men uchun juda katta mukofotdir. Bundan tashqari, jonli sport turlarini, ayniqsa xalqaro futbol o'yinlarini tomosha qilish men uchun juda hayajonli tajriba. Stadiondagi atmosfera, muxlislar o'rtasidagi do'stona munosabat va olomonning elektr energiyasi boshqa joyda takrorlash qiyin bo'lgan ijtimoiy tajribani yaratadi.

Ko'proq odamlarni bo'sh vaqtlarida sport bilan shug'ullanishga undash nuqtai nazaridan, menimcha, amalga oshirilishi mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta strategiyalar mavjud. Birinchidan, mahalliy hukumatlarning hamyonbop va arzon sport inshootlarini ta'minlash bo'yicha tashabbuslari juda foydali bo'ladi. Bundan tashqari, jamoat sport tadbirlarini tashkil etish qiziqish uyg'otishi va jamoatchilik ruhini rivojlantirishi mumkin. Maktablar va ish joylari ham turli xil dasturlar va odamlarni birlashtiradigan musobaqalar orqali sportni rag'batlantirishda muhim rol o'ynashi mumkin.

Katta sport tadbirlarini o'tkazishga kelsak, men chin dildan ularning ikki tomonlama qilich bo'lishi mumkinligiga ishonaman. Bir tomondan, ular mezbon davlatga o'zini global miqyosda namoyish etish, turizmni rivojlantirish va iqtisodiy o'sishni yaratish uchun ajoyib imkoniyatlar beradi. Bunday tadbirlar, shuningdek, jamiyatlarni birlashtirishi va milliy g'urur tuyg'usini singdirishi mumkin. Biroq, boshqa tomondan, ular mahalliy resurslarga yuk bo'lishi va ko'pincha qoplanmasligi mumkin bo'lgan katta xarajatlarga olib kelishi mumkin. Oxir oqibat, "hamma yaltiragan narsa ham oltin emas" va foyda kamchiliklardan ustun bo'lishini ta'minlash uchun ehtiyotkorlik bilan rejalashtirish va amalga oshirish zarur.

questions.prompt: Music education is as important as math and science.
questions.sampleA1: Music is good. I like music. Math is okay too. Music is fun.
questions.sampleA2: I like music. It is fun to listen to music and play music. Math is important too, but music is good because it makes me happy. I think music is important for kids.
questions.sampleB1: I think music education is important. It's good for kids to learn music. For example, they can learn to play an instrument. Also, music can help them be creative. However, math and science are also important for jobs, so maybe they are both equally important.
questions.sampleB2: That's a really interesting statement, and to be honest, it's one I feel quite strongly about. On the one hand, I can completely see why some people would argue that subjects like maths and science should take priority. After all, they're the ones that tend to open doors to well-paid careers in fields like engineering, medicine and technology, and they're often seen as the backbone of a country's economy. From that point of view, it's easy to understand why music sometimes gets pushed to the sidelines. That said, I'd argue that music education is every bit as valuable, just in different ways. For one thing, learning an instrument teaches you discipline, patience and creativity - skills that come in handy in absolutely every walk of life. On top of that, there's a growing body of research suggesting that music actually boosts brain development and can even improve a child's performance in other subjects, including maths. So the idea that music is somehow a soft option really doesn't hold water. Personally, I'm firmly of the opinion that a well-rounded education should strike a balance between the two. At the end of the day, school isn't just about churning out workers for the economy - it's about nurturing well-rounded human beings. Music brings so much joy and helps kids express themselves, which is priceless. So while I understand the pressure to prioritise the so-called core subjects, I genuinely believe that cutting music out of the curriculum would be a big mistake in the long run.

questions.sampleAnswer: Honestly, the debate over the importance of music education compared to subjects like math and science is a social experience that touches on both pragmatic and philosophical aspects of education. Personally, I genuinely believe that music education holds an equal footing when it comes to shaping well-rounded individuals. To begin with, music education plays a crucial role in developing discipline and focus. Students who learn to play an instrument or read music often have to dedicate numerous hours to practice, thereby enhancing their ability to concentrate and persevere. In my own experience, learning the piano taught me the value of patience and hard work, which translated seamlessly into other academic areas. Moreover, there's substantial evidence that music education improves cognitive skills. Engaging with music requires complex brain activity, from memorizing notes to understanding rhythm and harmony, which can bolster students’ problem-solving abilities. Such skills are incredibly beneficial, not just in math and science, but across a multitude of disciplines. In addition to cognitive benefits, music education encourages teamwork through group activities such as choir or band. These settings allow students to work together towards a common goal, cultivating a sense of camaraderie and collaboration. I remember being part of a high school orchestra, where we had to be in sync with each other, and it taught me the importance of listening and adjusting to others. On the flip side, one could argue that there are limited career opportunities in music, and subjects like math and science are more practical in terms of job prospects. While it is true that not all students will turn their musical talents into a career, the skills and experiences gained are transferable and really invaluable in any field. Furthermore, not every student is musically inclined, just as not every student excels in math or science. In conclusion, while math and science are undeniably crucial for practical reasons, music education provides unique benefits that can't be overlooked. As the saying goes, "All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy." Incorporating music into the curriculum could very well nurture not just academic proficiency, but also creativity and emotional intelligence, which are incredibly important in today's world.

Rostini aytsam, musiqa taʼlimining matematika va fan kabi fanlar bilan solishtirganda ahamiyati haqidagi bahs taʼlimning ham pragmatik, ham falsafiy jihatlariga tegishli boʻlgan ijtimoiy tajribadir. Shaxsan men, musiqa taʼlimi har tomonlama rivojlangan shaxslarni shakllantirishda teng oʻringa ega, deb chin dildan ishonaman.

Avvalo, musiqa taʼlimi intizom va diqqatni rivojlantirishda muhim rol oʻynaydi. Biror asbobda chalishni yoki musiqani oʻqishni oʻrganadigan talabalar koʻpincha mashq qilishga koʻp soatlab vaqt ajratishlari kerak, shu bilan birga ularning diqqatini jamlash va qatʼiyatlilik qobiliyatini oshiradi. Shaxsiy tajribamda, pianino chalishni oʻrganish menga sabr-toqat va qattiq mehnatning qadrini oʻrgatdi, bu esa boshqa akademik sohalarga ham bemalol oʻtdi.

Bundan tashqari, musiqa taʼlimi kognitiv qobiliyatlarni yaxshilashiga oid sezilarli dalillar mavjud. Musiqa bilan shugʻullanish murakkab miya faoliyatini talab qiladi, notalarni yodlashdan tortib ritm va uygʻunlikni tushunishgacha, bu talabalarning muammolarni hal qilish qobiliyatini oshirishi mumkin. Bunday ko'nikmalar nafaqat matematika va fanda, balki ko'plab fanlarda ham juda foydali.

Kognitiv foydalarga qoʻshimcha ravishda, musiqa taʼlimi xor yoki orkestr kabi guruh mashgʻulotlari orqali jamoaviy ishni ragʻbatlantiradi. Ushbu muhitlar talabalarga umumiy maqsad sari birgalikda ishlashga, oʻrtoqlik va hamkorlik tuygʻusini rivojlantirishga imkon beradi. Oʻrta maktab orkestrida qatnashganim esimda, u yerda biz bir-birimiz bilan hamohang boʻlishimiz kerak edi va bu menga boshqalarni tinglash va ularga moslashish muhimligini oʻrgatdi.

Boshqa tomondan, musiqada cheklangan martaba imkoniyatlari bor va matematika va fan kabi fanlar ish topish nuqtai nazaridan amaliyroq, deb taʼkidlash mumkin. Toʻgʻri, barcha talabalar ham oʻzlarining musiqiy isteʼdodlarini martabaga aylantirmaydilar, lekin olingan koʻnikmalar va tajribalar har qanday sohada oʻtkazilishi mumkin va juda qimmatlidir. Bundan tashqari, har bir talaba ham musiqaga moyil emas, xuddi har bir talaba matematika yoki fanda muvaffaqiyat qozonavermaganidek.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, matematika va fan amaliy sabablarga koʻra inkor etib boʻlmaydigan darajada muhim boʻlsa-da, musiqa taʼlimi eʼtibordan chetda qoldirib boʻlmaydigan noyob afzalliklarni taqdim etadi. Aytishlaricha, "Faqat ish bilan mashg'ul bo'lish odamni zerikarli qiladi". Oʻquv dasturiga musiqani kiritish nafaqat akademik mahoratni, balki ijodkorlik va hissiy intellektni ham rivojlantirishi mumkin, bu esa bugungi kunda juda muhimdir.
